title: Add Breadcrumb Nav
content: Create breadcrumb. Container: flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-500. Items: flex items-center gap-2. Link: hover:text-gray-700 hover:underline. Separator: slash or chevron icon between items. Current page: text-gray-900 font-medium, not a link. Home: optional home icon as first item. Truncation: ellipsis for long paths.

variants.simple: Create breadcrumb navigation showing page hierarchy.
variants.detailed: Create breadcrumb. Container: flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-500. Items: flex items-center gap-2. Link: hover:text-gray-700 hover:underline. Separator: slash or chevron icon between items. Current page: text-gray-900 font-medium, not a link. Home: optional home icon as first item. Truncation: ellipsis for long paths.
variants.advanced: Create comprehensive breadcrumb navigation. Structure: nav with aria-label="Breadcrumb", ordered list of links. Separators: chevron (>), slash (/), or custom icon between items. Home link: optional home icon as first crumb, link to home page. Current page: last item, not a link (use span), aria-current="page". Truncation: for deep hierarchies, collapse middle items to "...", expand on click or hover to show full path. Mobile: horizontal scroll or dropdown for long breadcrumbs. Dynamic generation: auto-generate from URL path or route config, fetch page titles via API. Rich snippets: BreadcrumbList schema.org structured data for SEO. Styling: customizable separator, active/inactive colors, spacing. Categories: show category hierarchies for products, articles. Back navigation: optional "Back to [parent]" link for single-level back. Multi-path: when item belongs to multiple categories, primary path only or dropdown with alternatives. Last crumb: show or hide based on context (show on listing pages, hide if same as page title). Loading: skeleton placeholder during dynamic loading. Max items: configurable max visible items before collapse. Accessibility: proper nav landmark, links vs spans, screen reader friendly separators (visually hidden text or aria-hidden icons). Integration: work with React Router, Next.js routing, or static configuration.
